clear_size_metric.place: an optional top-level per-episode field beside pieces_placed, never a leaf inside result or result.event_counts, because verify_run compares a result object's keys with the replay's exactly
clear_size_metric.source: the engine's own per-step events.lines_cleared (1/2/3/4), the same event result.event_counts.lines_cleared sums, so the histogram adds up to result.lines
clear_size_metric.summary: each agent's summary carries the totals of its episodes' histograms

objective_record.compatibility: a suite record without the section is older and still verifies, which is what keeps the runs of this experiment written before it existed valid; a record whose configuration has no Tetris agent must not carry it, because no writer emits one
objective_record.place: an optional top-level suite section beside the frozen heuristic mapping, never a leaf inside an episode or its result
objective_record.source: tetris.weights_record(): the declared weights, the well-depth cap and the tie-break rule
objective_record.verification: verify_run compares the recorded module name and weights with the current module's under the same exact type-and-key rules it applies to the heuristic mapping, so a suite that uses the Tetris agent cannot verify under a different objective merely because the change preserved its replayed choices; live play, the second path that writes suite records, records the same section for a live Tetris game
objective_record.why: the frozen heuristic mapping is recorded for every suite because every placement agent scores through it, and the Tetris agent's choices come from a second, separately declared objective; before this section existed a suite record was tied to its objective only through the replayed choices, so a changed objective still verified whenever the change happened to preserve them

predeclared_objective.note: the capture records the module digest and the digest of the notes' declared-objective section — the weights table and rationale alone, delimited by the predeclared-objective markers — and is not overwritten while both still match; the cited record was created after this capture, which check-predeclaration re-checks mechanically. The capture was re-made three times as the marked section changed; the final text is the objective alone (the provenance and replay-guarantee note now sits below the end marker), and the superseded captures are kept beside it

objective.tie_break: first highest-valued placement in canonical enumeration order: orientation ascending, then column ascending

publication.compared_paths: every path either tree tracks, plus this worktree's untracked files, derived from Git: a declared list can omit a path the task changes, and the review found that hole twice (first this record's own result.json, then any tracked path outside the list); 46 paths in the published tree at this round's run
publication.note: publication is service-owned and gated on an exact-tree approval, so the branch ref and the PR head move together: the probe asserts that the two refs name one commit and that the commit descends from the recorded base, and it compares the repaired paths' content — per-file sha256 in the published clone beside this worktree's — instead of their presence, which cannot tell a published repair from an earlier publication that contains the same file names. When the contents differ it requires the difference to be exactly the repair this worktree holds uncommitted, prints the differing paths and reports the earlier-publication state instead of calling the repair published; a published tree differing from a clean worktree fails
